And whoever would not accept his confession,
he would no longer turn by persuasion, but with the sword.
And to those who turned,
not only in carnal lusts and a multitude of marriages of freeborn women and concubines,
and that a man might divorce his wife whenever he wished and take another,
and that they should keep a daytime fast of only one month in the year,
and eat all night until daybreak, did he confirm;
but also in the other world that is to come after the resurrection,
rivers of honey and milk and wine,
and trees laden with delectable fruits,
and reclining upon couches of gold and beds of purple and fine silk {OCR?},
and marriage with women who surpass the sun in beauty,
he said that God has prepared for the people of his confession.
And when he had lived ten years and two months after he began to prophesy, as they say,
his kingdom was handed down from one to another, and it grew and expanded and seized most of the territories of the Romans and the entire kingdom of the Persians.
And there arose among them philosophers, mathematicians, and physicians, who surpassed the ancients in subtlety of intellect.
Not that they laid another foundation,
but upon the Greek foundations
they completed majestic scientific edifices by means of a more polished style
and very thorough investigations.
So that we, whose own people received wisdom through the translators,
all of whom were Syrians,
behold, have now been reduced to seeking wisdom from them.
As for the books of their law, however, that is, the canons of marriages,
and divorces,
and ablutions,
and the manner of prayers,
and the amount of alms,
and the types of commercial transactions and loans,
and the division of inheritances,
and the emancipation of slaves,
all of this they have expanded so greatly,
that during the whole time of his life, even when one of them is thoroughly trained in them,
he is not able to master the questions and answers in them as is fitting.
Moreover, many heresies sprang up among them,
just as they say that he himself said:
"My community will be split into more than seventy factions;
one of them will be saved,
and the rest consigned to the fire,"
meaning by the one, that which is guided by his conduct,
and by the rest, the innovators of novelties.
